name: Gemma 4 12B Unified
short: Google DeepMind's 11.95B open-weight encoder-free multimodal model (Apache 2.0, 256K) for local agents; GPQA 78.8%, LiveCodeBench v6 72%, runs in 16GB VRAM.
modalities: Text, image, audio in; text out
standout: The unified multimodal runner: an encoder-free open model that sees, hears and codes on a 16GB gaming GPU.
tradeoff: A 12B ceiling shows quickly on hard reasoning and long agent chains; no OpenCode Zen or OpenRouter route.
